concerns.text: FR-000 and FR-007 mandate verification of matching Participant IDs across *separate* datasets and automatic test switching based on that match. The ingestion tasks only operate on a single dataset (ds000208), never load a second “reward” dataset, and decide design_type solely from overlap within the same file. This weakens the functional requirements by removing the composite‑dataset ID‑matching step required by the spec.

SC-002 requires a measurable artifact that records total compute time for the entire workflow. The CI workflow enforces a 6‑hour limit but only writes a boolean pass/fail flag (ci_runtime_verification.json); it does not produce a concrete timing log that can be inspected to verify the success criterion.
